name: HRWS-D3
description: Digital moving television over SSB — NBTV's great-grandchild. Delta-coded D1 stripes at 1–2 fps: per frame, only the 16×16 blocks that changed are sent (INTRA or DELTA), on the same 4-FSK 500 Bd · K=7 Viterbi chain. A walking INTRA refresh heals losses by itself; live webcam, video files and a moving test card; live listen, WAV in/out, loopback lab, freshness map, replay-at-received-pace.
author: Ham Radio Web Studio
